sensitivePaths.label: Stop a VM or a container
Stop a VM or a container
Act on a node (reboot, shutdown)
sensitivePaths.warning: Every VM and container on it goes down with it.

sensitivePaths.label: Delete (VM, container, snapshot, storage…)
sensitivePaths.warning: Disks and data go with it.

agentGuide: Base path /api2/json. Cluster: GET /api2/json/cluster/resources (every VM, container, node, storage with status, cpu, mem); nodes: GET /api2/json/nodes; one node: GET /api2/json/nodes/<node>/status. VMs: GET /api2/json/nodes/<node>/qemu (and /qemu/<vmid>/status/current, /qemu/<vmid>/config); containers: same under /lxc. Start, stop, shutdown, reboot: POST /api2/json/nodes/<node>/qemu/<vmid>/status/start (stop, shutdown, reboot; same for lxc). Snapshots: GET and POST /api2/json/nodes/<node>/qemu/<vmid>/snapshot. Tasks: GET /api2/json/nodes/<node>/tasks?limit=20, one: /tasks/<upid>/status. Storage: GET /api2/json/nodes/<node>/storage. Answers are in data. The token's privileges are set in Proxmox (Permissions → API Tokens); a 403 means the token lacks one. The token is set by Allkin.
